modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: A single place to record, check, assign and track resident complaints across projects.

requirements.title: Single place to record complaints
requirements.description: The system must give one place to record resident complaints across projects instead of calls, WhatsApp messages and Excel notes.

requirements.title: Check and assign complaints
requirements.description: The system must let complaints be checked and assigned, so that non-genuine complaints and society-level work do not reach the builder.

requirements.title: Track complaints to closure
requirements.description: The system must track each complaint so it is not lost, delayed or raised again because nobody follows it.

requirements.title: Resident agreement before closure
requirements.description: The system must prevent complaints from being closed without the resident agreeing.

requirements.title: Clear roles, steps and time limits
requirements.description: Complaint handling must run on one system with clear roles, steps and time limits instead of depending on people and chat messages.

requirements.title: Data on repeated defects across projects
requirements.description: The system must provide data on which defects repeat across projects.
